item.title: 1989 Jeep Cherokee XJ Turn Signal Stays Solid / Won’t Blink + Dashboard Indicator Solid with Headlights
item.description: Symptoms On my 1989 Jeep Cherokee XJ, the right turn signal indicator on the dashboard would light up whenever I turned on the headlights or parking lights. The right turn signal also would not blink normally. Instead, it stayed solid when activated. Common symptoms include: Turn signal indicator glowing dimly Signal stays solid instead of flashing Turn signal comes on with headlights Fast blinking or no blinking One side acting weird with parking lights The Fix Basics Obviously, the first step is to check that the bulb isn’t just burnt out.
